rubric: The run ran out of budget with slices still to do.

criteria.reason: the change is bigger or harder than the plan allowed for, and the run ran out of room before it finished

reading.why: The budget is spent with three of five slices done and the agent says the change is bigger than planned, so the change is bigger or harder than the plan allowed for and the run ran out of room.

ruledOut.question: reason
ruledOut.label: plan_wrong
ruledOut.why: The change outgrew the plan and the run ran out of room. It is not: the approved plan cannot be built as written: a step names something that does not exist, or the steps contradict each other or the code.

ruledOut.question: reason
ruledOut.label: env_broken
ruledOut.why: The change outgrew the plan and the run ran out of room. It is not: the environment is at fault: a service, a tool, a credential, the network or the container, not the change.

ruledOut.question: reason
ruledOut.label: flaky_tests
ruledOut.why: The change outgrew the plan and the run ran out of room. It is not: a test fails and passes on its own, with no change to the code it covers.

ruledOut.question: reason
ruledOut.label: undeclared_scope
ruledOut.why: The change outgrew the plan and the run ran out of room. It is not: the work needs files or changes the plan does not name.

ruledOut.question: reason
ruledOut.label: other
ruledOut.why: The change outgrew the plan and the run ran out of room. It is not: none of these fits, or the evidence does not say.
